# Sneaky Clean

> Locally owned mobile auto detailing company based in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. We come to homes, offices, apartments, and approved locations in Murfreesboro, Smyrna, La Vergne, Nashville, Franklin, Brentwood, and surrounding Middle Tennessee.

Key facts:
- Refresh Detail from $199 (maintained vehicles, about 2-2.5 hours)
- Full Reset Detail from $299 (daily drivers and family vehicles, about 4-5 hours)
- Paint correction, ceramic coating, and motorcycle detailing quoted after review
- Monthly plan: $150/month for one detail per month; alternate between two vehicles
- Online booking with live appointment times runs Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday: https://www.sneakycleantn.com/
- Other days available as rush slots by text: 615-481-0464
- 5.0 Google rating
